name: cl_Ti6O12
title: (TiO2)6 cluster
description: Gas-phase (TiO2)6, a standard titania-nanocluster global-optimisation target; DFT global minima of small (TiO2)n are compact, with 4-/5-fold coordinated Ti and one or two terminal Ti=O groups (Qu & Kroes, JPCB 110, 8998 (2006); Lamiel-Garcia et al., Nanoscale 9, 1049 (2017)). The NEP89 putative GM has these features (two titanyl O at 1.69 A, four 4- and two 5-fold Ti, nine 4-membered Ti2O2 rings, no O-O bonds), but its identity with the DFT GM was not verified; the default repulsive guard (Ti-O r0 = 1.695 A) is marginally active on the titanyl bonds (0.3 meV).
